description: This file defines the Data Access Object (DAO) interface for accessing 'notes' in a Room database, including methods for CRUD operations and search functionality.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object interface for performing database operations related to 'Note' entities.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by the 'updated' timestamp in descending order, returning a Flow of a list of Note objects.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a specific note by its ID asynchronously, returning a Note object or null if not found.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database, replacing any existing note with the same primary key, and returns the new row ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note from the database.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches for notes where the title or content contains the query string, returning a Flow of matching notes ordered by 'updated'.
